title: Bosun Realm 36: Strongbox Contract v1
description: Machine-readable delta schema contract for Strongbox (Realm 36), extending Archetype Sovereign Vault and Universal Meta-Envelope with realm-specific payload attributes.

public_key_fingerprint.description: Hex or OpenSSH fingerprint of the public key.

hardware_token_serial.description: Serial number of backing hardware security token (HSM / YubiKey).

derivation_path.description: BIP-32 / BIP-44 hierarchical deterministic key derivation path.
